messages:
maya: Heads up — digging into the new per-unit cost card in Console. Numbers don't add up when cached responses are served; per-model cost looks inflated. Anyone seen this?

yang: I noticed something similar earlier today. Looks like cache savings are applied at router time, but the Console pulls raw token counts from the ledger -> might be double counting the tokens that were later credited. :thinking_face:

phil: Can you paste a concrete example? I saw a tenant where model A shows 0 tokens in ledger but nonzero cost in the UI, felt like a join/mapping issue.

maya: Minimal repro: tenant T123, route /billing/summary, timeframe last_7d. Console shows model=redwood-7b cost=$42. Cache saved tokens: 120k but token_cost still uses full 300k. Screenshot: https://redwood.tools/s/abc123 (just a mock link).

sarah: Likely culprit: the cache_credit table stores prefix hits with different invocation_ids, and our dashboard join to token_ledger doesn't dedupe by invocation_id+model_variant. Quick SQL I sketched: `SELECT inv_id, model, sum(gross_tokens) AS gross, sum(cache_saved) AS cache, sum(gross)-sum(cache) AS net FROM token_ledger LEFT JOIN cache_credits USING (inv_id) GROUP BY inv_id, model` — need to adapt fields to our schema.

devex: This is the API shape debate we had last sprint. Two options: 1) internal telemetry returns net_tokens per-invocation so Console displays a single number, or 2) telemetry returns both gross_tokens and cache_credit and Console computes net (preferred for explainability). UX folks prefer option 2 so users can drill into "why".

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolled out metric fix to staging at 1712065000 — monitor staging dashboards for anomalies.

maya: If Console computes, we need a stable contract: `gross_tokens`, `cache_credit`, `cache_origin` (prefix vs kv), and `model_sku`. Also for multi-model chains we need a clear attribution strategy (first-owner vs pro-rated).

yang: Agreed. Also routing policy (sticky vs variant-fallback) affects who gets the cache savings. We should add a `cache_origin` tag and `routing_path` so Console can surface that the saving actually came from a previous variant.

phil: For the Console card, small UI change: add a tooltip "net = gross - cached_prefix - kv_cache" and a link to docs explaining attribution. That helps customer support triage without chasing backend joins.

sarah: I'll prototype the API change: POST /internal/telemetry/invocations?fields=gross_tokens,cache_credit,cache_origin,model_variant,routing_path — will post a PR for the telemetry schema and sample payloads later today.

maya: :thumbsup: Thanks. If someone (yang/phil/devex) can sanity-check the SQL and the proposed schema before I file a formal Console bug, that'd be great.

yang: I'll run the SQL against last_30d and share diffs. Expect some surprises around prefetch credits.

phil: +1 to locking down the contract first — once Console starts computing net we can't flip assumptions mid-rollout.

maya: Ok cool. I'll leave a bug with the reproduce steps and link this thread. Thanks all!
